_description: 5-year recurring Roth conversion ages 65-69 with 3% inflation and inflation_adjusted COLA. Verifies multi-year execution and COLA escalation.
_rationale: Age 65, conversion 65-69 (5 years), initial amount $30k, COLA=inflation_adjusted with inflation=3%. Year 0 (age 65): $30,000. Year 1: $30,000 × 1.03 = $30,900. Year 2: ~$31,827. Year 4 (age 69): $30,000 × 1.03^4 ≈ $33,764.20. Year 5 (age 70): conversion ended, rothConversionGross=0. Traditional $500k, Roth $0, Taxable $50k to cover tax. Verify conversion gross matches COLA schedule and zeroes out after endAge.
name: Roth Conversion — Multi-Year COLA
